Method of Attack: Encrypts files on the compromised machine and demands a ransom in Monero cryptocurrency (XMR) to decrypt the affected files.
Attack Vector: Uses social engineering or exploits for vulnerabilities in software or hardware to elevate privileges.
Indicators of Compromise: .redeem file extension, Read Me.TXT ransom note

Method of Attack: Encrypts files on a compromised machine and demands that victims pay a ransom in Bitcoin for file decryption.
Indicators of Compromise: .beamed file extension, RIP YO DOCUMENTS.txt ransom note containing the attacker’s Bitcoin address

Method of Attack: Encrypts files on a victim’s machine, deletes shadow copies, claims to have stolen information from the victim, and threatens to publish the stolen data if the victim fails to make contact.
